claims: The Bible verse quoted by Jules Winnfield (Samuel L. Jackson) in Pulp Fiction is a modified version of Ezekiel 25:17.
Tarantino and Roger Avary expanded the Bible verse for Pulp Fiction.
Tarantino and Roger Avary turned the Bible verse into a dramatic monologue for Pulp Fiction.
The Bible verse in Pulp Fiction is not a direct scriptural quote.
The Bible verse quoted in Pulp Fiction emphasizes vengeance.
The Bible verse quoted in Pulp Fiction emphasizes the "tyranny of evil men".
